title: Adding points on y² = x³ − 2x + 1
caption: The line through P = (0, 1) and Q = (1, 0) has slope −1. It meets the curve again at P (it is tangent there), so the third point is P itself; reflecting it in the x-axis gives P + Q = (0, −1).
alt: The elliptic curve y squared equals x cubed minus 2x plus 1, with the line y = 1 − x through (0, 1) and (1, 0), and the point (0, −1) marked as the sum.
description: The curve has an oval for −1.6 ≤ x ≤ 0.6 and an open branch from x = 1.
The chord through P = (0, 1) and Q = (1, 0) is y = 1 − x, with slope λ = −1.
Substituting gives x²(x − 1) = 0, so the third intersection is at x = 0 again: the line touches the curve at P.
Reflect that point in the x-axis: P + Q = (0, −1).
